meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence

давно.gloss: for a long time; long ago

meanings.note: with present: Я давно здесь = I've been here a long time

examples.trans: You haven't been interested in me for a long time.

examples.text: Вспомнил? Я давно тебя не интересую.
examples.trans: Now you remember? You haven't been interested in me for a long time.

meanings.note: in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер

examples.text: Добрый вечер, Вика. С Новым годом!

examples.text: Это отличная игра! Хочешь с нами поиграть? Бери карты.
examples.trans: This is a great game! Want to play with us? Take the cards.

издеваться.gloss: to mock, to kid, to mess with

meanings.en: to mock, to tease; colloquially 'are you kidding me?'
meanings.note: Ты что, издеваешься? = Are you kidding me?

examples.trans: There's someone here to see you.
